carousel.title: 7 Types of Friends When the Bill Arrives
carousel.cover_image: A group of Pakistani friends sitting around a dining table at a restaurant, looking at a single receipt with varied shocked, nervous, and sneaky expressions.

points.headline: The 'I Only Had Chai' Guy
points.body: He ordered one tea, ate half your chicken karahi, but insists on paying exactly Rs 180. Math genius.
points.image: A young guy smiling sheepishly while holding a small teacup, looking at a massive spread of food on the table.

points.headline: The Signal Disappears Friend
points.body: The second the waiter brings the check, their 4G mysteriously drops and JazzCash refuses to open.
points.image: A person aggressively shaking their smartphone while staring at a loading screen, standing outside a dhaba.

points.headline: The Fake Wallet Searcher
points.body: Pats six pockets in slow motion, knowing deep down they brought zero cash and a dead card.
points.image: A guy frantically checking every pocket of his shalwar kameez with an overly dramatic worried face.

points.headline: The 'Send Me Account Details' Phantom
points.body: Promises to transfer via Easypaisa the moment they reach home. You will see that money in 2027.
points.image: A friend waving goodbye from a Careem back seat, holding up their phone as the car pulls away.

points.headline: The Group Bank
points.body: Pays the entire Rs 18,000 bill on their card just to avoid the awkward 20-minute table calculation.
points.image: A tired-looking girl tapping her credit card at a counter while her friends cheer in the background.

points.headline: The Exact Paisa Splitter
points.body: Calculates service tax, GST, and extra naan down to the rupee. Uses SplitSol so nobody gets cheated.
points.image: A person smiling calmly while tapping on a smartphone screen at a restaurant table.

points.headline: The Memory Loss Patient
points.body: Genuinely forgets they ate dinner with you last night. 'Wait, did we get fast food or biryani?'
points.image: A guy scratching his head with thought bubbles showing images of burgers and biryani plates.

carousel.caption:
